guidelines.title: button variant roles
guidelines.rule: Text = less-pronounced (typical in dialogs and cards; on cards, text buttons keep emphasis on card content). Contained = high-emphasis (elevation + fill); primary to the app. Outlined = medium-emphasis: important but not the primary; lower than contained, higher than text.
pass_when: Variant matches that role map (text / outlined / contained).
fail_when: Contained used for a low-emphasis card action, or text used as the app's primary.
guidelines.do_not_claim: One-primary page cap as this variant-map row; M3 max-two-actions (not on this MUI page).

guidelines.title: dont type number
guidelines.rule: Do not use `type="number"` on Text Field — allows `e`/`+`/`-`/`.` and silently discards others; scroll increment is accidental. MUI points at GOV.UK number inputs. Dual-cite; do not invent a winner vs Apple number formatter. Fail native `type=number`. Formatted numeric control is Apple's claim, not a house pick.
pass_when: The Text Field does not use native `type="number"`. A formatted numeric control may exist as Apple's claim — not required or banned here.
guidelines.do_not_claim: A house winner vs Apple number formatter; that formatted numeric entry is forbidden.

guidelines.title: helper text changes field height
guidelines.rule: Helper text changes field height — a field with helper text next to one without will misalign. Equalize by passing a space character as `helperText` on the sibling.
pass_when: Adjacent fields with/without helper text stay aligned (sibling gets space `helperText` or equivalent).
fail_when: Adjacent fields misalign because only one has helper text.
guidelines.do_not_claim: Helper association `id` (next row) as this height row.

guidelines.title: explicit id for label helper
guidelines.rule: Explicit `id` for label + helper association — input linked to label and helper (`for` / `aria-describedby`). Until hydration, a TextField without an explicit `id` will not have associated labels.
pass_when: TextField has an explicit `id`; label uses `for`; helper is `aria-describedby`.
fail_when: No explicit `id`, so label/helper are not associated (including pre-hydration).
guidelines.do_not_claim: Visible-label existence (`forms.field_labels.visible_label`) as this association row.

guidelines.title: most alerts dont need titles
guidelines.rule: Most alerts don't need titles — summarize in a sentence or two (question or statement tied to the buttons). Use `role="alertdialog"`. Title-bar alerts only for high-risk (e.g. potential loss of connectivity). Users should understand the choices from title and button text alone.
pass_when: Ordinary alerts have no title bar; copy is a sentence or two tied to the buttons; `role="alertdialog"`. Title-bar only for high-risk. Choices are understandable from title (if any) and button text alone.
fail_when: Title-bar on a non-high-risk alert; missing alertdialog role; choices that cannot be understood from title + buttons.
guidelines.do_not_claim: Banned-title list (next row) as this "most don't need titles" row.

guidelines.title: avoid apologies alarm ambiguity in dialog titles
guidelines.rule: Avoid apologies, alarm, or ambiguity in dialog titles — not "Sorry for the interruption", "Warning!", or "Are you sure?". Dual-cite Atlassian error-title (3–4 words, not "what to do") — MUI is the banned-title list on the dialog itself.
pass_when: Dialog title (when present) is not an apology, "Warning!", or "Are you sure?".
guidelines.do_not_claim: `actions.confirm.specific_consequences` as a delete of this banned-list row. Overlap with Actions 40: `actions.confirm.specific_consequences`.

guidelines.title: confirmation cancel discards
guidelines.rule: Confirmation Cancel discards — touching Cancel cancels the action, discards any changes, and closes. (Example: listen to ringtones; commit only on OK.)
pass_when: Confirmation Cancel discards changes and closes; commit is only on the confirm control.
fail_when: Confirmation Cancel keeps changes, or Cancel commits.
guidelines.do_not_claim: `actions.close_saves_separate_cancel` (Close keeps) as a merge that deletes this Cancel-discards claim. Overlap with Actions 40: `actions.close_saves_separate_cancel`.

guidelines.title: non modal dialogs allowed
guidelines.rule: Non-modal dialogs are allowed — they do not interrupt interaction behind them. MUI cites NN/g modal vs non-modal and demos a persistent cookie banner. Dual-cite extra-harvest NN/g 7 numbered modal rules; this row is MUI's explicit non-modal permission + cookie-banner pattern.
pass_when: A non-modal (e.g. persistent cookie banner) does not block interaction behind it when that pattern is used.
fail_when: A cookie-banner/non-modal pattern implemented as a blocking modal; or treating "non-modal allowed" as permission to modal nonessential off-flow (NN/g 5–7 still apply).
guidelines.do_not_claim: A winner that deletes `nng.modal-and-nonmodal-dialogs`. Overlap with extra 73: `nng.modal-and-nonmodal-dialogs`.
